title: eQEP
text: Quadrature encoder pulse block used to derive position, direction, and speed, 3 inputs, 12 outputs, {Position counter reset mode} sets Resets position counter Reset on an index; {Module} sets the eQEP module to obtain position, direction, and speed, {Position counter mode} sets the mode that matches how input to eQEP peripheral is encoded, {Positive rotation} sets the direction of rotation, {External clock rate} sets the measurement resolution 2x resolution: Count the rising/falling, {Quadrature direction flag output port} sets the creates port for direction flag, {Invert input QEPxX polarity} sets the inverts polarity of eQEP input, {Index pulse gating option} sets the enables gating of index pulse with strobe, {Sample time} sets the frequency at which block reads position, {Output position counter} sets the outputs position counter signal, {Maximum position counter value (0~4294967295)} Specifies maximum position counter value, {Enable set to init value on index event} sets the enables option to set initialization value for position, {Set to init value on index event} sets the initialization value for position counter Rising, {Enable set to init value on strobe event} sets the enables option to set initialization value for position, {Set to init value on strobe event} sets the s initialization value for position counter Rising, {Enable software initialization} sets the enables option to set initialization value for position, {Software initialization source} Specifies initialization source of position counter Input, {Initialization value (0~4294967295)} sets the initialization value for position counter, {Output position counter error flag} sets the outputs position counter error flag, {Output latch position counter on index event} sets the latches position counter on index event, {Index event latch of position counter} sets the configures position counter to latch on an event Rising, {Output latch position counter on strobe event} sets the latches position counter on strobe event, {Strobe event of latched position counter} sets the configures position counter to latch on strobe Rising, {Enable QEP capture} sets the enables edge capture unit, {Output capture timer} sets the outputs capture timer, {Output capture period timer} sets the outputs capture period, {eQEP capture timer prescaler} sets the prescales capture timer clock frequency, {Unit position event prescaler} sets the prescales quadrature clock, {Enable and output overflow error flag} sets the outputs overflow error flag when capture timer, {Enable and output direction change error flag} sets the outputs direction change error flag, {Capture timer and position} sets the qEP capture latch mode On position counter, {Unit timer period (0~4294967295)} sets the s unit timer period, {Output capture timer latched value} sets the outputs capture timer latched value, {Output capture timer period latched value} sets the outputs capture timer period latched value, {Output position counter latched value} sets the outputs position counter latched value, {Enable position-compare sync signal output} sets the enables position compare sync signal, {Sync output pin selection} sets the gPIO pin used for sync signal Index pin is used for sync, {Compare value source} sets the source of value for position comparison Specify via, {Position compare shadow load mode} sets the shadow mode for generating position compare sync signal Load, {Position compare value (0~4294967295)} sets the value for comparing postiton, {Sync output pulse width (1~4096)} sets the pulse width of position compare sync output, {Polarity of sync output}, {Watchdog timer enable} sets the enables watchdog time-out flag, {Watchdog timer} sets the time-out value for watchdog timer, {Position counter error interrupt enable} sets the enables position counter error interrupts, {Quadrature phase error interrupt enable} sets the enables quadrature phase error interrupts, {Quadrature direction change interrupt enable} sets the enables quadrature direction change, {Watchdog timeout interrupt enable} sets the enables watchdog timeout interrupts, {Position counter underflow interrupt enable} sets the enables position counter underflow, {Position counter overflow interrupt enable} sets the enables position counter overflow, {Position-compare ready interrupt enable} sets the enables position compare ready interrupts, {Position-compare match interrupt enable} sets the enables position compare match interrupts, {Strobe event latch interrupt enable} sets the enables strobe event latch interrupts, {Index event latch interrupt enable} sets the enables index event latch interrupts and {Unit timeout interrupt enable} sets the enables unit timeout interrupts. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Module
params.values: eQEP module to obtain position, direction, and speed eQEP1 (default) | eQEP2 | eQEP3

params.name: Position counter mode
params.values: Mode that matches how input to eQEP peripheral is encoded Quadrature-count (default) | Direction-count | Up-count | Down-count

params.name: Positive rotation
params.values: Direction of rotation Clockwise (default) | Counterclockwise

params.name: External clock rate
params.values: Measurement resolution 2x resolution: Count the rising/falling edge (default) | 1x resolution: Count the rising edge only

params.name: Quadrature direction flag output port
params.values: Creates port for direction flag off (default) | on

params.name: Invert input QEPxX polarity
params.values: Inverts polarity of eQEP input off (default) | on

params.name: Index pulse gating option
params.values: Enables gating of index pulse with strobe input off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which block reads position counter 0.0001 (default) | -1 | scalar

params.name: Output position counter
params.values: Outputs position counter signal on (default) | off

params.name: Maximum position counter value (0~4294967295)
params.values: Specifies maximum position counter value 4294967295 (default) | integer in [0, 4,294,967,295]

params.name: Enable set to init value on index event
params.values: Enables option to set initialization value for position counter off (default) | on

params.name: Set to init value on index event
params.values: Initialization value for position counter Rising edge (default) | Falling edge

params.name: Enable set to init value on strobe event
params.values: Enables option to set initialization value for position counter off (default) | on

params.name: Set to init value on strobe event
params.values: Sets initialization value for position counter Rising edge (default) | Depending on direction

params.name: Enable software initialization
params.values: Enables option to set initialization value for position counter off (default) | on

params.name: Software initialization source
params.values: Specifies initialization source of position counter Input port (default) | Set to init value at start up

params.name: Initialization value (0~4294967295)
params.values: Initialization value for position counter 2147483648 | integer in [0, 4,294,967,295]

params.name: Position counter reset mode
params.values: Resets position counter Reset on an index event (default) | Reset on the maximum position | Reset on the first index event | Reset on a time unit event

params.name: Output position counter error flag
params.values: Outputs position counter error flag on error off (default) | on

params.name: Output latch position counter on index event
params.values: Latches position counter on index event off (default) | on

params.name: Index event latch of position counter
params.values: Configures position counter to latch on an event Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Software index marker via input port

params.name: Output latch position counter on strobe event
params.values: Latches position counter on strobe event off (default) | on

params.name: Strobe event of latched position counter
params.values: Configures position counter to latch on strobe Rising edge (default) | Depending on direction

params.name: Enable QEP capture
params.values: Enables edge capture unit off (default) | on

params.name: Output capture timer
params.values: Outputs capture timer off (default) | on

params.name: Output capture period timer
params.values: Outputs capture period off (default) | on

params.values: Prescales capture timer clock frequency 128 (default) | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 64

params.name: Unit position event prescaler
params.values: Prescales quadrature clock 128 (default) | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 64 | 256 | 512 | 1024 | 2048

params.name: Enable and output overflow error flag
params.values: Outputs overflow error flag when capture timer overflows off (default) | on

params.name: Enable and output direction change error flag
params.values: Outputs direction change error flag off (default) | on

params.name: Capture timer and position
params.values: QEP capture latch mode On position counter read (default) | On unit time-out event

params.name: Unit timer period (0~4294967295)

params.values: Shadow mode for generating position compare sync signal Load on QPOSCNT=0 (default) | Shadow disabled(load immediate) | Load on QPOSCNT=QPOSCMP
